events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the world lost the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable talent of Freddie Mercury today. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Drop
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that really showed them pushing boundaries and shaping the sound of the sixties.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today. His music and message continue to resonate, a true icon of peace and rock and roll.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman today. David Bowie would have been 80, and his incredible artistry and influence are still felt across music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: King's Birthday
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still gets hips shaking and hearts racing.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page's Riffs
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs are simply iconic.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Rod Stewart, who turns 82 today! Still rocking, still performing, still got that distinctive voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs' Special Day
angles.copy: Happy 66th to Suggs, the inimitable frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house down with those ska classics.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 71st to the one and only Paul Young! Still got that soulful voice that defined the 80s for so many.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Day
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! A true legend whose talent and heart shine as brightly as her rhinestones.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's Tunes
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, he's been a soundtrack to generations.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: 'Caribbean Queen' and 'When The Going Gets Tough' singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy's Hits
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean! His hits still bring sunshine to any playlist.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Remembering the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony today. A momentous occasion for music history, celebrating the legends who shaped the sound.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark's Charm
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm and those infectious pop tunes.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the Apple Corps rooftop in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for their iconic final performance. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil's Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 76th to the legendary Phil Collins! From those iconic drum fills to unforgettable ballads, a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh's Charm
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to more recent dramatic roles, a true British screen icon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Day
angles.copy: Happy 46th to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, he's still bringing the moves and the hits.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Del Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Frost, his characters are simply unforgettable.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Music Lives On
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died' today. Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper – gone too soon, but their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: 'Never Gonna Give You Up' singer Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick's Still Got It
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still 'never gonna give us up' on those incredible vocals and infectious tunes.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Marley's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of peace, love, and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole's Genius
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting genius whose melodies and lyrics have touched millions.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away in 2012.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Remembering the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston, today. Her incredible talent and iconic songs live on.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the day Take That announced their split in 1996, before their triumphant return.

angles.name: Hearts Broken
angles.copy: Remembering the day Take That broke millions of hearts in 1996. Thankfully, it wasn't forever, and they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: UB40's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 68th to Ali Campbell, the voice of UB40! Still bringing those reggae vibes and classic hits.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed's Genius
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to Ed Sheeran! From busking to selling out stadiums, his songwriting genius is undeniable.
